mentions.name: OpenCooler
mentions.description: OpenCooler is a silent, drop-in water cooling unit designed to be used in applications such as labs, temperature-controlled mattress covers, and pet coolers. It is built as a more affordable alternative to expensive commercial water cooling products and doubles as a learning project.
mentions.problem: Current market water cooling products are too expensive.
mentions.source_excerpt:
The "OpenCooler"
A silent, drop-in water cooling unit for labs, temp controlled mattress covers, pet coolers, whatever. The current market stuff is too expensive and it looked like a good learning project
